---
name: Feature request
about: Something Schema could usefully do
labels: enhancement
---

## What you are trying to find out

Describe the question about a database that Schema cannot currently answer.

## What you do instead today

A `psql` session, a catalogue query of your own, another tool.

## Scope

Schema is a read-only explorer. It will not gain commands that change a
database, manage migrations or administer a server, so a request along those
lines will be declined however useful it would be elsewhere.
